meta.headline: Trade commute stress for cozy calm.
meta.text: Rotate paper tiles, link a thread of light, and watch lanterns drift up into the dusk. Levels take about 3 minutes.

tiktok.headline: Trade commute stress for calm
tiktok.text: Link a thread of light and send lanterns up into the dusk. Calm, cozy, about 3 minutes a level.
